subject: Physics
q: A particle of mass $m$ is attached to one end of a light spring of force constant $k$ and natural length $l$; the other end is fixed. The system rotates with angular speed $\omega$ about the fixed end in gravity-free space. What is the extension of the spring?
hint: The centripetal radius is the stretched length $l+x$, not the natural length.
solution: If $x$ is the extension, the spring force supplies the centripetal force: $kx=m\omega^2(l+x)$. Hence $x(k-m\omega^2)=ml\omega^2$, so $x=ml\omega^2/(k-m\omega^2)$.
